name: opencode-human-bot
description: Local-first AI coding sessions with isolated workspaces, durable checkpoints, and physical editor safeguards.

commands.title: OpenCode Human Bot: Open Folder in New Window
OpenCode Human Bot: Configure AI Provider API Key

opencodeHumanBot.pythonPath.description: Python executable used to launch the local engine.

opencodeHumanBot.ai.provider.description: Provider used by the autonomous coding session. API keys are stored in VS Code SecretStorage.

opencodeHumanBot.ai.model.description: Provider model name; select a model supported by your account.

opencodeHumanBot.ai.baseUrl.description: Optional HTTPS API base URL for a compatible endpoint. Loopback HTTP is permitted for local testing.

opencodeHumanBot.editingMode.description: Native uses VS Code edits; physical uses PyAutoGUI keyboard interaction.

opencodeHumanBot.desktop.coordinates.description: Optional screen-coordinate overrides: explorer_x, explorer_y, editor_x, editor_y, terminal_x, terminal_y.

opencodeHumanBot.desktop.explorerItems.description: Workspace-relative file paths mapped to calibrated Explorer click points, e.g. {"src/main.py":[[38,84],[140,160],[155,225]]}.

opencodeHumanBot.desktop.cursorLine.description: Move the editor caret to this 1-based line before typing; 0 preserves the current caret behavior.
